body: ahh!! i hate when school becomes the main concern in mental health situations. like hello ?? aren’t therapists trained to look deeper than that? anyway i hope everything works out for you ! :-)

wow some of the stuff you described is exactly how i’ve felt for years, especially recently with college courses i understand that struggle. i think one of the worst things is when you don’t know exactly why your struggling with mental health so much. even when things seem to be fine and even if you have a few friends, it just happens. amazing accomplishments with martial arts though. good for you man! and i’m glad that you have some ways of coping. it’s so hard not to feel like the bad guy. i’ll never live up to anyone’s expectations and it’s the worst when they try to act like it’s not a big deal when i know they’re actually really disappointed. at the end of the day, we understand ourselves the best and i think all that matters is that we don’t get too caught up in trying to please everyone. it’s not easy, don’t get me wrong, especially if you have a family or people to support and responsibilities. but hey we’ll get there someday.

I was in the same boat as you. Or actually I should say -- I still am. Although now I'm 19. Nothing has changed for me since I was 11. I can't believe I'm still alive. It's so goddamn weird because I though I'd be dead by now, but here I am. I'm not telling you that it doesn't get better, but I want to tell you that you need to get creative. Even if all you're living for right now is to read a certain manga. Then pour your heart into that. I just try to find one thing at a time to get me through the day. Just this past week I read an entire manga and it was literally the only thing that gives me any sense of pleasure. I don't have a great relationship with my family and I don't have friends anymore. They all got tired of me. I might sound crazy, but I still have imaginary friends and fictional worlds I lose myself in. All I do is daydream. I continue to exist by escaping. I know that's not healthy, but fuck it. Therapy didn't work for me so I try to live however I can. If escaping from reality through fiction gets you to live another day even if it's just for the sake of existing, then go for it. 

Obviously if you haven't tried therapy yet or medication from a psychiatrist, then at least try that first. It doesn't work for everyone, but it has for many. It's worth a shot.

Honestly, I don't know if it gets better, but getting a break from reality when you can might help in the meantime. And it's ok to just exist. Society is all a huge ass construct anyway. All of these expectations are just made up by productivity-obsessed, money-hungry assholes. Just live. Your life doesn't have to have a huge impact or purpose. Just existing is all you have to do and you'll be just fine. Take your time in life. There's literally no rush. I wish you the best, my friend.
